# Local presentation assets

These assets are served locally. No company files or data are sent to their upstream sources.

- Font Awesome Free **6.4.0**: the icon set already used by the existing Dashboard, now stored locally. CSS and `fa-solid-900`, `fa-regular-400`, `fa-brands-400` font files came from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/`. Upstream: `https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/6.4.0`. License preserved in `fontawesome/LICENSE.txt` (icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT).
- Source Serif 4: normal and italic variable fonts from `https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/sourceserif4`. License preserved in `source-serif/OFL.txt` (SIL Open Font License 1.1). The full fonts include Vietnamese glyphs. These downloaded files are bundled snapshots; the running app does not fetch upstream updates.

`chingluh-wordmark.svg`, `report-object.svg`, and the report tool SVG illustrations are original vector assets created for this workspace. They do not contain Nothing logos, proprietary fonts, or product imagery.
